text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick idea — run a 2-hour 'Spring Spotlight Sprint' in both offices: short micro-ceremonies + benefits Q&A table. Goal: 30 quick spot awards + run a 15-min benefits drop-in. Thoughts? :sun_with_face:

Diego: love it. When are you thinking? could do Tue afternoon. Also are awards taxable? need to flag to finance.

Maya (People Ops): Thinking Tue 5/3 3-5pm SF & Thu 5/5 3-5pm NYC. For tax — Leah, can you confirm if $50 gift cards need to be reported?

Leah: Short answer: yes, if gift cards > $100 per employee per year it's taxable. We should prefer $50 gift cards or non-monetary pins/stickers to avoid payroll reporting overhead. Will loop in Payroll.

Jordan: We can do digital vouchers (email codes) to avoid cash handling. Also, if managers approve on the spot, what's our approval flow?

Maya (People Ops): Approvals: spot awards under $75 auto-approved by People Ops lead; above $75 need manager + Finance sign-off. We'll surface that on the nomination tablet and on a printed checklist.

RewardsAdmin: Event setup checklist created: table, tablet, QR code to nomination form, paper certs, 30x small envelopes, signage.

Diego: Catering? small bites + allergy labels required. We have staff with severe nut allergy — avoid mixed trail mix. Also vegan option please.

Maya (People Ops): Noted. Catering: mini bagels, fruit cups (vegan), boxed cookies (gluten-free label). Budget set to $600 for both offices. Procurement code: PO-SPR-2026.

Leah: Payroll flagged — keep per-person gifts <= $75 to avoid W-2 reporting admin. If we go digital vouchers, code it as 'gift' in expense system.

Jordan: Volunteer rota: SF — Diego, Maya; NYC — Jordan + Priya. Diego can you bring tablet and mobile hotspot for forms?

Diego: Yep laptop + hotspot. Also can print quick certs on-site. Who's doing the 30s shout when awarding?

Maya (People Ops): I'll do a short script and drop it in Drive. Example: "In 30 seconds: name, why, one sentence of thanks." Keep it energetic.

RewardsAdmin: Calendar invites sent. QR for nominations: https://forms.redwood.in/spot?event=SPRING2026

Maya (People Ops): Final asks: confirm volunteers by 4/20, Leah to confirm payroll note in a short doc, Jordan to reserve rooms and order catering by 4/22.

Leah: I'll post a short 'tax note' doc in Drive and ping Payroll.

Jordan: Catering ordered for NYC. SF catering TBD — Diego to confirm vendor.

Diego: Confirmed vendor for SF + allergy labels. I'll bring extra name tags and a clip-on mic if we need it.

Maya (People Ops): Amazing — closing checklist will go out Monday. :sparkles: Thanks team!
